Grade: SNE  /  visual-impairment / Grade 9
Subject: GRADE
Strand: HADITH
Topic 2.2: Selected Hadith • Hadith on Unity • Hadith on Avoidan ce of ill motives
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 8

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Selected Hadith • Hadith on Unity • Hadith on Avoidan ce of ill motives, part of HADITH in SNE  /  visual-impairment / Grade 9 GRADE.

Key inquiry question: Why is the unity of Muslims important? 2. Why should Muslims avoid ill motives?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

A. deduce lessons from the Hadith on unity and avoidance of ill motives among Muslims,

   Learning focus: This outcome is part of Selected Hadith • Hadith on Unity • Hadith on Avoidan ce of ill motives in the Kenya CBC curriculum.
   In class: Your teacher will guide you to discuss, practise, and demonstrate this skill using examples from Kenya.
   At home: Explain this point to a parent using an example from your school, home, or community.

B. explain the relevance of the Hadith on unity and avoidance of ill motives in the life of a Muslim,

   Learning focus: This outcome is part of Selected Hadith • Hadith on Unity • Hadith on Avoidan ce of ill motives in the Kenya CBC curriculum.

   At home: Explain this point to a parent using an example from your school, home, or community.

   In class: Your teacher will guide you to discuss, practise, and demonstrate this skill using examples from Kenya.
   At home: Explain this point to a parent using an example from your school, home, or community.

D. honour Hadith as the second source of law and spiritual guidance.

   Learning focus: This outcome is part of Selected Hadith • Hadith on Unity • Hadith on Avoidan ce of ill motives in the Kenya CBC curriculum.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

• Learning to learn: The skill of sharing learnt knowledge is enhanced as learners discuss the lessons derived

from the selected Hadith in groups.

• Creativity and imagination: the skill of making connections is enhanced when learners explain the relevance of

the selected Hadith in the life of a Muslim and make notes.

• Communication and collaboration: the skill of teamwork is enhanced as learners dramatise the effects of ill

motives.

Values:
● Unity is enhanced when learners discuss the lessons derived from the Hadith on unity in groups.

● Love enhanced as learners discuss the lessons derived from the Hadith on unity in groups.
